derivation: from G1223 (διά) and the base of G939 (βάσις);

occurrences.text: And beside all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed: so that they which would pass from hence to you cannot; neither can they pass to us, that would come from thence.
And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us.
By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry land: which the Egyptians assaying to do were drowned.
